关键词: Amended and Restated Calculation Agency Agreement
Amended and Restated Exchange Rate Agency Agreement
主要内容: The document titled 's181606k.htm' is a Form 6-K filing by Royal Bank of Canada, published on January 8, 2016. It includes several exhibits related to agreements between the bank and its agents. Exhibit 99.1 is a Distribution Agreement dated April 30, 2015, and Exhibit 99.2 is an Amendment No. 1 to that agreement, dated January 8, 2016. Additionally, Exhibits 99.3 and 99.4 are Amended and Restated Calculation Agency Agreement and Amended and Restated Exchange Rate Agency Agreement, both dated January 8, 2016. The filing is signed by James Salem, Executive Vice-President and Treasurer of Royal Bank of Canada, on January 8, 2016.
